name: Permanent-account onboarding, consent, and verification signal contract
acceptanceCriteria: Signed-out users can reach Splash and the one-page age/account-side choice before permanent account creation or sign-in.
The one-page entry records age assurance metadata only and never stores raw ID images, selfies, videos, face scans, or full birth dates.
Login, signup, email confirmation, and account restore wait for canonical profile, required consent, and verification facts before routing.
Required Privacy Policy and Terms consent is explicit, persisted, auditable, and never inferred from continuing onboarding.
One global own-row Realtime subscription refreshes account verification without duplicate screen subscriptions.
Every configured MCP server activates its mapped Bip skills and authority boundary through a machine-verified routing contract.
Synthetic teen, parent, account-switch, and second-user journeys pass before public rollout.
